english.title: Use / cause / permit vehicle use at Stansted Airport London - fuel / exhaust system likely to cause danger / nuisance
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[used a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[caused a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be used]_
(C)_[permitted a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be used]_

at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) to which the road traffic enactments do not apply at Stansted Airport London when the condition of the

(D)_[fuel]_
(E)_[exhaust]_

english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 5(7) and 2(2) of the Stansted Airport - London Byelaws, 1996 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
